High liver enzymes on a blood test usually mean liver cells are irritated, inflamed, or injured and leaking enzymes—most commonly **ALT** and **AST** —into your bloodstream . Many people have no symptoms at first, and mild elevations are often temporary.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF15haQQPqpkkjVaZr_Hk7eTLCB3g159OkLdD7J1aKJ4wCzyIZRv4vvXGdPaUUyMPOuxsVM2-LLKvFvaBCOJ3VamlpN-arSxZGB2jPvku2NsIpVXtHH5LNJoweIKWi_Pn7NeqF11iSrjiT75kRn7T9XyjpBIzcsvLjjMcJ2sTD7eEatyW-)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF197LGuUn1mP4f9XCrxCg_edDb8Am420Puo4xI-7hFE6xXim9TkV1TzVaZ0usXT8zhBdRywW7bIu37nZ4JkSr5xThg0BdnhZKK0KYl9gA76cY_etyMTKUMZJfVW9yFRFvWkpQN4PYJg5Om6gmuZJ5msIgmsjA8XKxoWtGMSbg2QH9rnYyDDfeI7NOCLlC91dEJeJwyBBVzkt8Y-9PEUBC_fUAJqAMFVWnKOV4yXI-zg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF195jnzaCSNtGh5paJYD4z0vjKcaC79Mr07e1b6An5QqxLar22qcKC2NcRBy8_0_FgHlJFAibnvJDjrjczYpN_jU-MG5brpcPhA7oh05mjf9MxOuHuF_1xqWvtqub_tKFfBJDoMpMW_TnsG4Gp01vgEDMtvJ5WAZeuOXb-UeyT7pFEanlVOFOoWKG2mGgCw)

- **Short-term & non-liver triggers:** Intense workouts or muscle injury (which can raise AST), recent viral illnesses, or dehydration.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tzejBONW9Ko&t=60)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF197LGuUn1mP4f9XCrxCg_edDb8Am420Puo4xI-7hFE6xXim9TkV1TzVaZ0usXT8zhBdRywW7bIu37nZ4JkSr5xThg0BdnhZKK0KYl9gA76cY_etyMTKUMZJfVW9yFRFvWkpQN4PYJg5Om6gmuZJ5msIgmsjA8XKxoWtGMSbg2QH9rnYyDDfeI7NOCLlC91dEJeJwyBBVzkt8Y-9PEUBC_fUAJqAMFVWnKOV4yXI-zg)

### Possible Symptoms
Mild elevations often cause **no symptoms** and show up on routine lab work. ### Diagnosis & Treatment
A doctor reviews which specific enzymes are high (such as ALT, AST, ALP, or GGT), how much they are elevated, and whether you have symptoms or risk factors.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1Z_ePxq4yZs&t=320)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF197LGuUn1mP4f9XCrxCg_edDb8Am420Puo4xI-7hFE6xXim9TkV1TzVaZ0usXT8zhBdRywW7bIu37nZ4JkSr5xThg0BdnhZKK0KYl9gA76cY_etyMTKUMZJfVW9yFRFvWkpQN4PYJg5Om6gmuZJ5msIgmsjA8XKxoWtGMSbg2QH9rnYyDDfeI7NOCLlC91dEJeJwyBBVzkt8Y-9PEUBC_fUAJqAMFVWnKOV4yXI-zg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF195jnzaCSNtGh5paJYD4z0vjKcaC79Mr07e1b6An5QqxLar22qcKC2NcRBy8_0_FgHlJFAibnvJDjrjczYpN_jU-MG5brpcPhA7oh05mjf9MxOuHuF_1xqWvtqub_tKFfBJDoMpMW_TnsG4Gp01vgEDMtvJ5WAZeuOXb-UeyT7pFEanlVOFOoWKG2mGgCw)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESowEBxCJF17CLpK4B5ws0RTX5n5jWSIuONWJGawIIvhd_biX09n0-JZj9KTCm2upRVztjk9idP0fKdFfblMWTDA26sWldxX6gj4mBl8H6otg0JRiMxrslMy5f7LpXfDRoK0pg954TUTWmelx6cgatz2gO-ninCSb8eJGg9_0TTR7LTqFH57V2mudzot_8yR-xQdU8_dLkZWxJXEG0-kJ1mBpzskEF)

- **Next steps:** Your provider may repeat blood tests after a few weeks to see if levels drop on their own, or order extra blood work (like hepatitis panels, iron studies, or metabolic labs) and imaging such as an ultrasound.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF15haQQPqpkkjVaZr_Hk7eTLCB3g159OkLdD7J1aKJ4wCzyIZRv4vvXGdPaUUyMPOuxsVM2-LLKvFvaBCOJ3VamlpN-arSxZGB2jPvku2NsIpVXtHH5LNJoweIKWi_Pn7NeqF11iSrjiT75kRn7T9XyjpBIzcsvLjjMcJ2sTD7eEatyW-)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF197LGuUn1mP4f9XCrxCg_edDb8Am420Puo4xI-7hFE6xXim9TkV1TzVaZ0usXT8zhBdRywW7bIu37nZ4JkSr5xThg0BdnhZKK0KYl9gA76cY_etyMTKUMZJfVW9yFRFvWkpQN4PYJg5Om6gmuZJ5msIgmsjA8XKxoWtGMSbg2QH9rnYyDDfeI7NOCLlC91dEJeJwyBBVzkt8Y-9PEUBC_fUAJqAMFVWnKOV4yXI-zg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF14Fmbaftt3xnYLNSU0lNhz8GE2QL7-YsncTqezIBKXVpvBA5OMqk2Ku_hXLuCsf41Amfuyy0OEG26BMYLQXJlYZVXNCByYp7PfcE3AUzMA43f8HoORpXun3Bw6wsQVYSNFFsXk0P89KqA2ILl4GDed4Dojtl2WpeBMlY6SVj4RDuwItFpt3L443Lg5BD9ldC)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF16n8JxzulEuciCVHp1r89Tn6PJKgVfGSVKr5BvKflA1_FOoYFQ8EOwNoihgdidLjECTwBXq3zxAkHegow9BtjgFEU1nDNNkuxkeO9BY9-nrByWHVEKqClybRjTsUtm2hl874X9z3vdNZG-YlNXTbBppC1CQ4U8eBA1pyHfhV)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tzejBONW9Ko&t=60)
- **Care:** Treatment targets the root cause. It can involve cutting back on or avoiding alcohol, adjusting medications or supplements **only with your doctor's guidance** , managing weight or blood sugar, or treating a specific infection or liver condition.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF15haQQPqpkkjVaZr_Hk7eTLCB3g159OkLdD7J1aKJ4wCzyIZRv4vvXGdPaUUyMPOuxsVM2-LLKvFvaBCOJ3VamlpN-arSxZGB2jPvku2NsIpVXtHH5LNJoweIKWi_Pn7NeqF11iSrjiT75kRn7T9XyjpBIzcsvLjjMcJ2sTD7eEatyW-)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF1yA-2XNZJUjOkcSQ6t760i4EzrLA1_EAqqAlQnjyDIk_z6qSI8lMgtLpQB93DhQdvZvaeb_NgxYRdSgvROLDGEGecH5G1jcyXAW3ogUV7-me5Av1fEmK90IKWGfI8HLuhOdYX4Jx4IEwTS8xN1HnjVHimP8O7ajEXBzMp3ND9IGwyeF5KLDdKA7I4ndhrPLyrum8VA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF197LGuUn1mP4f9XCrxCg_edDb8Am420Puo4xI-7hFE6xXim9TkV1TzVaZ0usXT8zhBdRywW7bIu37nZ4JkSr5xThg0BdnhZKK0KYl9gA76cY_etyMTKUMZJfVW9yFRFvWkpQN4PYJg5Om6gmuZJ5msIgmsjA8XKxoWtGMSbg2QH9rnYyDDfeI7NOCLlC91dEJeJwyBBVzkt8Y-9PEUBC_fUAJqAMFVWnKOV4yXI-zg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXm5RKj83sBaLcNUZI5rUQP2V-fXkrVgqTU6uOg8dQfsGRefZ5yg2ElKgNqcDmDV5YNRYQC_cLiMHqJ9Ivioj5GZAQqOIhhWkQ13jQj4phOSK1zmcRqSSpE11Ly_LBxrAJpHRqh3UA2Ms)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tzejBONW9Ko&t=60)

For more details on patterns and evaluation, see [Elevated Liver Enzymes](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF15haQQPqpkkjVaZr_Hk7eTLCB3g159OkLdD7J1aKJ4wCzyIZRv4vvXGdPaUUyMPOuxsVM2-LLKvFvaBCOJ3VamlpN-arSxZGB2jPvku2NsIpVXtHH5LNJoweIKWi_Pn7NeqF11iSrjiT75kRn7T9XyjpBIzcsvLjjMcJ2sTD7eEatyW-) at Cleveland Clinic or [Elevated liver enzymes](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF195jnzaCSNtGh5paJYD4z0vjKcaC79Mr07e1b6An5QqxLar22qcKC2NcRBy8_0_FgHlJFAibnvJDjrjczYpN_jU-MG5brpcPhA7oh05mjf9MxOuHuF_1xqWvtqub_tKFfBJDoMpMW_TnsG4Gp01vgEDMtvJ5WAZeuOXb-UeyT7pFEanlVOFOoWKG2mGgCw) at Mayo Clinic.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF15haQQPqpkkjVaZr_Hk7eTLCB3g159OkLdD7J1aKJ4wCzyIZRv4vvXGdPaUUyMPOuxsVM2-LLKvFvaBCOJ3VamlpN-arSxZGB2jPvku2NsIpVXtHH5LNJoweIKWi_Pn7NeqF11iSrjiT75kRn7T9XyjpBIzcsvLjjMcJ2sTD7eEatyW-)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF195jnzaCSNtGh5paJYD4z0vjKcaC79Mr07e1b6An5QqxLar22qcKC2NcRBy8_0_FgHlJFAibnvJDjrjczYpN_jU-MG5brpcPhA7oh05mjf9MxOuHuF_1xqWvtqub_tKFfBJDoMpMW_TnsG4Gp01vgEDMtvJ5WAZeuOXb-UeyT7pFEanlVOFOoWKG2mGgCw)

### When to Seek Care Promptly
Contact your healthcare provider to review abnormal lab results. Seek urgent medical care if high liver enzymes come with **jaundice** (yellowing of the skin or eyes), dark urine, pale stools, severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, confusion or sudden mental changes, or easy bruising/bleeding.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF1yA-2XNZJUjOkcSQ6t760i4EzrLA1_EAqqAlQnjyDIk_z6qSI8lMgtLpQB93DhQdvZvaeb_NgxYRdSgvROLDGEGecH5G1jcyXAW3ogUV7-me5Av1fEmK90IKWGfI8HLuhOdYX4Jx4IEwTS8xN1HnjVHimP8O7ajEXBzMp3ND9IGwyeF5KLDdKA7I4ndhrPLyrum8VA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF195jnzaCSNtGh5paJYD4z0vjKcaC79Mr07e1b6An5QqxLar22qcKC2NcRBy8_0_FgHlJFAibnvJDjrjczYpN_jU-MG5brpcPhA7oh05mjf9MxOuHuF_1xqWvtqub_tKFfBJDoMpMW_TnsG4Gp01vgEDMtvJ5WAZeuOXb-UeyT7pFEanlVOFOoWKG2mGgCw)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1Z_ePxq4yZs&t=320)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXhLzLofeJ9MKyx5aT5fyv0K2IjmJ_-UJiD0H6ycF-B19vyOAVmoaLTDDdTKJ0vk9dNbpFw2C1cUTcFLM2uHnjkmk02aZHkyHvpEd9zruYE9mDI8QS2SH3x3lkmMwCrojdUHLnN5qGXmH5VBDJ8krm-A)To help tailor this information, are you looking at **specific lab numbers** (like ALT or AST), experiencing **any symptoms** , or trying to understand **potential causes and next steps**?

items.text: Metabolic & lifestyle factors: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD, formerly fatty liver disease), excess weight, high blood sugar/diabetes, high cholesterol, or alcohol use. Medications & supplements: Over-the-counter pain relievers (especially acetaminophen), prescription drugs like statins or certain antibiotics, and some herbal supplements. Short-term & non-liver triggers: Intense workouts or muscle injury (which can raise AST), recent viral illnesses, or dehydration. Infections & chronic conditions: Viral hepatitis (A, B, or C), autoimmune hepatitis, bile duct or gallbladder issues, thyroid disorders, or iron/copper buildup (hemochromatosis or Wilson's disease).
